v.break.start.text: Movement break! Stand up and copy the apprentice.

v.break.jumps.1.text: Jump, jump, jump! Keep your knees soft when you land.

v.break.jumps.2.text: Two little hops, then one big jump!

v.break.jumps.3.text: Jump up and reach for the ceiling.

v.break.jumps.4.text: Now shake out your hands and wiggle your fingers.

v.break.stretch.1.text: Reach both arms up high, as high as they can go.

v.break.stretch.2.text: Now bend down slowly and reach for your toes.

v.break.stretch.3.text: Stand up and roll your shoulders back, nice and slow.

v.break.stretch.4.text: Take a big breath in, and let it all the way out.

v.break.march.1.text: March in place with your knees up high.

v.break.march.2.text: Swing your arms as you march. Left, right, left, right.

v.break.march.3.text: Keep marching, and turn all the way around.

v.break.march.4.text: Slow your steps down, and come to a stop.

v.break.balance.1.text: Stand tall on both feet, with your arms out wide.

v.break.balance.2.text: Lift one foot and balance. Count to five.

v.break.balance.3.text: Now the other foot. Stay steady.

v.break.balance.4.text: Both feet down. Take a slow, deep breath.

v.break.shake.1.text: Shake your hands out, like you are flicking off water.

v.break.shake.2.text: Shake your arms, then your shoulders.

v.break.shake.3.text: Shake your legs, one and then the other.

v.break.shake.4.text: Now stand still and let everything go quiet.

v.break.done.text: All loosened up. Back to the quest!

v.break.rest.text: Let's rest our eyes for a moment.
